Thu 3 Sept 2026, 10:00 to 11:1S, room 4.2, London

Present: Marco Bianchi (chair, notes), Chris Dunn (Data Analyst, FP&A). Chris

chose not to bring a companion.

Conflict: Rachel (HRBP for Finance) sat on the HI FP&A promotion panel on 12

May. She must not see or work on this case. File kept to MB only. i

Grievance (Chris's words, summarised)

I. Not promoted to Senior Data Analyst in the HI 2026 cycle. Says he met the

: level 4 criteria: led the merchant cohort model, trained 2 new analysts, ran the

Q! board pack data.

2. Panel feedback was "not ready for stakeholder management’. Never raised in I:ls
with Jonas before May.

3. Month-end overtime: about 14 extra hours a month, Jan to June, closing the
FP&#A pack. TOIL requests not approved.

Chris was calm’ and well prepared. Brought a printed list of dates. Says he does not

want to move teams, wants the decision looked at fairly.

Examples he gave: the cohort model was used in the Q1 board pack; he trained two

new starters in March; he covered month-end alone in April while Jonas was on

leave. i

What he is asking for

- Review of the promotion decision

- Written feedback against the career framework

- "TOIL or pay for the extra hours :

Agreed

- MB to meet Jonas Berg by Thu 10 Sept. Chris asked that Jonas hears about it
from MB first. Agreed.

- MB to get the 12 May panel scoring sheet from Tom Whitfield (chaired the :
